set.body:
Final independent gate for declaring the volregger-to-ScalaFIM motion port complete.

Contracts: completion is not just feature count; the result must satisfy vision.md and AGENTS.md standards for a typed Scala 3 computational core.

Deliverables: audit of public APIs for algebraic/opaque/smart-constructor shape, dependency boundary review, docs/README update, fixture/benchmark evidence summary, and a final unsupported-feature ledger.

Acceptance: motionJVM/test and motionJS/test pass; testAll either passes or any unrelated blocker is documented with exact file/error; generated fixtures and benchmark commands are recorded; docs/plans/motion.md says what is complete, what is intentionally deferred, and why.
set.title: Close out volregger motion port with API and verification audit
